headline: Mariam's father reaches settlement with MP Nazrul in death case
summary: The complainant has agreed to an out-of-court settlement, stating he filed the initial charges of abetment of suicide out of 'instant suspicion'.

caption:
From accusations of abuse to an 'amicable relationship'—Mariam's father reaches a settlement with MP Gazi Nazrul.

Mariam Khatun's father, SM Masum Billah, has reached an out-of-court settlement with former Jamaat-e-Islami MP Gazi Nazrul Islam and his first wife, Maksuda Islam.

The settlement was presented in the Dhaka Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrates' Court on Wednesday, where Masum Billah stated he seeks an 'amicable family relationship' with the lawmaker.

Masum Billah had previously accused the couple of physically and mentally abusing Mariam, the MP's second wife, in a case filed following her death.

In a written agreement, the father acknowledged that the initial charge of abetment of suicide was filed out of 'instant suspicion' and that he now believes his daughter did not die due to abuse or provocation.

The court granted bail to Maksuda Islam on a Tk 5,000 bond until October 22, citing her age and gender, while Nazrul's bail application was rejected as the police investigation is ongoing.

State lawyer Omar Faruq Faruqi noted that the case cannot be privately settled in court, and the investigating officer will continue the process and submit a report.

Mariam's body was recovered on September 20 from an official residence complex for lawmakers in Dhaka.

The case follows the expulsion of Gazi Nazrul Islam from Jamaat-e-Islami on July 22 for moral misconduct after he confirmed Mariam was his second wife.
